questions.question: What least number must be added to 213, so that the sum is completely divisible by 9?
questions.solution:
For this to be divisible by 9, sum of numbers at different places must be divisible by 9

⇒ Sum = 2 + 1 + 3 = 6

instead of 6 there must be 9, so that it will be divisible by 9

∴ 3 must be added from the number to make it divisible by 9

questions.question: A can do a work in 12 days and B in 24 days. If they work on it together for 4 days, then what fraction of work is left?
questions.solution:
Work done by A in 1 day is 1/12th of the total work

Work done by B in 1 day is 1/24th of the total work

According to the problem statement, work left can be given as

⇒ 1 - 4 × (1/12 + 1/24)

⇒ 1 - ½ = ½

∴ The ½ of the total work will be left

questions.question: What is the area (in sq cm) of an equilateral triangle of side 6 cm?
questions.solution:
Area of equilateral triangle of side 6 cm can be given as,

⇒ Area of triangle = √3 × (6) ²/4 = 9√3

∴ the area of the triangle is 9√3 cm²

questions.question: What is the effective discount on two successive discounts of 20% and 25%?
questions.solution:
Given:

The successive discount are 20% and 25%.

Formula used:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 20%, Y = 25%

⇒ 20 + 25 - 500/100

⇒ 45 - 5 = 40%

∴ The single equivalent discount is 40%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

Let the Selling price before discount be Rs. 100

Now the effective discount after 2 successive discounts can be given as

⇒ 100 × (1 - 20/100) (1 - 25/100) = 100 × 0.8 × 0.75

⇒ final selling price is Rs. 60

⇒ Discount is 100 - 60 = Rs. 40

**∴ the discount percentage is 40%**

questions.question: The average weight of P, Q and R is 47 kg. If the average weight of P and Q be 32.5 kg and that of Q and R be 48.5 kg, then what is the weight of Q (in kgs)?
questions.solution:
Let the weight of P, Q and R be p, q and r

According to the problem statement

⇒ (p + q + r)/3 = 47

⇒ p + q + r = 141 ----(i)

Now given that average weight of P and Q is 32.5 kg

⇒ (p + q) /2 = 32.5

⇒ p + q = 65 ----(ii)

Now, (i) - (ii)

⇒ r = 141 - 65 = 76 ----(iii)

Now given that average weight of Q and R is 48.5 kg

⇒ (q + r)/2 = 48.5

⇒ q + r = 97 Using (iii)

⇒ q = 97 - 76 = 21 kg

∴ the weight of q is 21 kg

questions.question: A shopkeeper by selling 5 items, earns a profit equal to the selling price of 1 item. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the selling price be x

Five items sold at Rs. 5x

Now given profit is equal to selling price of 1 article = x

⇒ CP = SELLING PRICE - PROFIT = 5x - x = 4x

⇒ Profit percentage can be given as = x × 100/4x = 25%

∴ profit is 25%

questions.question: To cover a distance of 90 km in 2.5 hours what should be the average speed of the car in meters/second?
questions.solution:
Average speed can be given as total distance travelled/total time taken

⇒ average speed = 90/2.5 = 36 km/hr

To convert it into m/s multiply it by 5/18

⇒ 5 × 36/18

⇒ average speed = 10m/s

∴ average speed is 10 m/s

questions.question: The sum of a non - zero number and twenty times its reciprocal is 9. What is the number?
questions.solution:
Let the number be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y + 20/y = 9

⇒ y² - 9y + 20 = 0

⇒ (y - 5) (y - 4) = 0

the required number is 5 which satisfies the above given condition

∴ the value of required fraction is 5

questions.question: If the 3rd and the 5th term of an arithmetic progression are 13 and 21, what is the 13th term?
questions.solution:
Let the first term of AP be a and common difference be d

From the problem’s statement

⇒ 3rd term = a + (3 - 1) d = a + 2d = 13 ----(i)

⇒ 5th term = a + (5 - 1) d = a + 4d = 21 ----(ii)

Now (ii) - (i)

⇒ 2d = 8

⇒ d = 4, put this in (i)

⇒ a = 13 - 8 = 5

Now the 13th term can be given as a + 12d

⇒ 13th term = 5 + 12 × 4 = 53

∴ the 15th term of AP is 53

questions.question: What is the slope of the line perpendicular to the line passing through the points (-2, 3) and (2, 0)?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Points (-2, 3) and (2, 0)

**Formula used:-**

Slope of line which is passing through two points - 

Slope(m) = (y₂ - y₁)/(x₂ - x₁)

Slope of perpendicular line = -1/m

**Calculation:-**

According to the question -

Slope(m) = (0 - 3)/{2 - (-2)} = -3/4

∴ Slope of line perpendicular to given line = -1/(-3/4) = 4/3

∴ **The required slope is 4/3**

questions.question:
∆ABC is similar to ∆PQR. If ratio of perimeters of ∆ABC and ∆PQR is 1 : 2 and if PQ = 10 cm then what is the length of AB (in cm)?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fee11f04944f75260c93a2317ec4e7fc7b3c754807764a546722a8f03b8e383.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

ΔABC ∼ ΔPQR and PQ = 10 cm

Perimeter of ΔABC/Perimeter of ΔPQR = 1/2

**Formula used:-**

Perimeter of ΔABC/Perimeter of ΔPQR = AB/PQ = BC/QR = AC/PR

**Calculation:-** 

According to the question -

⇒ Perimeter of ΔABC/Perimeter of ΔPQR = 1/2 = AB/PQ

⇒ AB = (1 × 10)/2

⇒ AB = 5 cm

∴ **The required value of AB is 5 cm.**

questions.question:
If Sin θ = 12/13, then what is the value of Cot θ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0d9a0eae85c9be920ccfaf41cb77deaef291b6d2c40f131cddf450e05894a81.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Sinθ = 12/13, so Cosecθ = 13/12

**Formula used:-**

Sinθ = Opposite/Hypotenuse = 1/Cosecθ 

Cotθ = √(Cosec²θ - 1)

**Calculation:-**

Cotθ can be written as

⇒ Cotθ = √(cosec²θ - 1)

= √(13²/12² - 1)

= √{(169 - 144) /12²}

= √(5²/12²)

⇒ Cotθ = 5/12

∴ **Required value of Cotθ is 5/12 .**

questions.question: If area of country B is 20,00,000 sq km, what is its population?
questions.solution:
Given that population of B is 50 people per 100 sq km

⇒ 50/100 = 1/2 people per sq km

Now the area of B is 2000000 sq km

⇒ population = 1 × 2000000/2 = 1000000 people

∴ there are 1000000 people in country B.
